PNB Apprentices Result 2026 Out

Punjab National Bank conducted the PNB Apprentices 2026 online exam on 8th March 2026, where many candidates appeared from across the country. The PNB Apprentice Notification 2026 was released for 5138 apprentice vacancies in different branches. Now, the bank has declared the result, and candidates can check their status online. Candidates must note that this result is provisional, and final selection will depend on document verification and other required tests.

PNB Apprentices Result 2026 Download Link

The Punjab National Bank Apprentices Result 2026 PDF has been released on the official website for all candidates. This PDF includes the list of shortlisted candidates who have qualified in the online exam. Candidates can download the result PDF and check their name or roll number easily. It is advised to save a copy of the PDF for future reference during the next stages. Candidates who find their name in the list should now start preparing for document verification and other selection rounds.

Direct Link to Download PNB Apprentices Result 2026

How to Download PNB Apprentices Result 2026?

Checking your result is very easy if you follow the right steps. Just go step by step and you will find your result without any confusion.

  • First, visit the official website of Punjab National Bank
  • Then go to the “Careers” or “Recruitment” section on the homepage
  • Now click on the link that says “PNB Apprentices Result 2026”
  • Open the result PDF or enter your login details if asked
  • Search your roll number or name in the list
  • Finally, download the result and save it for future use

What After PNB Apprentices Result 2026?

After the result, selected candidates need to complete a few important steps for final selection. These steps make sure that only eligible candidates move ahead.

  • Document Verification: You need to show all your original documents like marksheets, ID proof, and certificates for checking
  • Language Test: In some cases, you must prove that you can read, write, and speak the local language
  • Medical Checkup: You have to give a medical fitness certificate to show you are fit for the job

Only candidates who clear all these steps will get final selection as PNB apprentices.

PNB Apprentice Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was the PNB Apprentice Result 2026 released?
Ans. PNB Apprentice Result 2026 has been released on 27th March 2026 on the official website. Candidates can now check their result online through the PDF list.

Q2. How can I check PNB Apprentices Result 2026 online?
Ans. You can check the PNB Apprentices Result 2026 by visiting pnb.bank.in, opening the result PDF, and searching your name or roll number in the list.

Q3. Is PNB Apprentice 2026 Result released in PDF format?
Ans. Yes, the PNB Apprentice 2026 Result is released in PDF format. It contains the names and roll numbers of shortlisted candidates.

Q4. What after PNB Apprentices Result 2026 is declared?
Ans. After the PNB Apprentices Result 2026, qualified candidates must go through document verification, language test, and medical checkup for final selection.

Q5. Is the PNB Apprentice Result 2026 final?
Ans. No, the PNB Apprentice Result 2026 is provisional. Final selection will be done after completing all required stages successfully.
